description: Reimburses the employer-borne part of the round-trip fare for a home visit: the full fare for a spouse or an unmarried employee's parents visit, and for a married employee's parents visit only the excess over 30% of the monthly standard wage, which the employee bears. The claim records that reimbursable amount as `quantity` in `MONEY`.

references.title: 国务院关于职工探亲待遇的规定 第六条: 探望配偶和未婚职工探望父母的往返路费由单位负担; 已婚职工探望父母的往返路费, 超过本人月标准工资30%的部分由单位负担.
